sections.title: Sound of letter erre
paragraphs: The name of this letter is (erre) /ˈɛrre/. It marks the sound /s/ in the word (sole) /ˈsɔ.le/, which means sun. This letter makes one sound in standard Italian.

sections.title: How to say erre
paragraphs: Place the tip of your tongue against the ridge behind your upper teeth. Let the air pass over your tongue so the tip vibrates rapidly. Vibrate your vocal cords at the same time. You can feel a buzz if you place your fingers on your throat.

sections.title: Spelling of erre
paragraphs: This letter always represents the sound /r/. You hear it at the start of a word in (roma) /ˈro.ma/. You also hear a stronger rolled sound when it is written double, as in (carro) /ˈkar.ro/.

sections.title: Mistakes to avoid
paragraphs: Do not make the sound of red by curling your tongue backwards. Instead, tap or roll the tip of your tongue quickly against the roof of your mouth. Keep the rest of your tongue low and relaxed.
